name: Wipe Me Down AI
tagline: Turn two photos into your Wipe Me Down AI dance video, with the original moves and sound.
description: Wipe Me Down AI creates an AI dance video from two photos, with the original Wipe Me Down moves and sound. Upload one clear half-body photo per person, pick a background (original kitchen, cozy living room, garage party or city rooftop), and download a ~15-second 9:16 1080p MP4 for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. No filming or editing needed.
